personality_one_liner: A trusted, industrial-grade bulk ordering platform that blends B2B utility with Material 3's approachable, tonal hierarchy and Indonesian commerce cues.

spacing.rule: Use 8pt grid system typical of Material guidelines. Ensure tap targets meet 44x44pt accessibility. Use generous bottom padding for sticky CTAs.

do's: Skip glass entirely for B2B dense utility screens. Use tonal separation instead.
dont's: Do not use blur headers; favor solid surfaceSecondary or brandTertiary tonal elevation.

screens.name: Buyer Home & Catalog
screens.purpose: Showcase bulk salt products and real-time warehouse stock availability.

states.loading: Skeleton UI representing stock banners and product cards.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty warehouse with 'No products available right now' and a refresh CTA.
states.error: Message 'Failed to load catalog' with Retry button.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll feed. Top: Hero stock banner (photo overlaid with gradient scrim and text). Below: Grid of products (2 columns). Use Material 3 tonal cards (surfaceSecondary) without heavy drop shadows.

screens.name: Product Detail & Calculator
screens.purpose: Allow buyer to select bulk quantity tiers (10/25/50/100kg), view automatic discounts, and checkout.

states.error: Message 'Could not fetch price tiers' with Retry button.

screens.layout: Hero product image on top. Mid section: horizontal scrollable quantity tier chips (Pill shaped, brandTertiary when selected). Bottom: Sticky checkout CTA above home indicator inside a solid surface container.

screens.name: Checkout & Payment Bottom Sheet
screens.purpose: Collect delivery zone and select payment (COD/Transfer) with receipt upload option.
screens.layout: Full-screen bottom sheet. Segmented control for COD vs Transfer. File upload zone with dashed borderStrong and Material upload icon. Sticky 'Confirm Order' CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Order Timeline & Chat
screens.purpose: Track order status sequentially and provide a 1-on-1 WebSocket chat or WhatsApp fallback.

states.error: Failed to load timeline or disconnected from chat.

screens.layout: Top: Vertical visual stepper (Pending -> Verification -> Processing -> In Delivery -> Completed). Bottom: Expandable chat interface or sticky WhatsApp deep-link CTA (brandPrimary pill).

screens.name: Admin Dashboard & Inventory
screens.purpose: View KPI metrics (Revenue, Turnover) and toggle product stock status.
screens.layout: Top: 2x2 grid of KPI cards using brandTertiary and surfaceSecondary. Bottom: List of inventory items with trailing Switch components to toggle In/Out of Stock.

screens.name: Admin Order Pipeline (Kanban)
screens.purpose: Manage orders across statuses and approve/reject payment receipts.

states.empty: No active orders in selected status.

screens.layout: AVOID multi-column horizontal layout. Use a vertical feed of order cards with horizontally scrollable status filter chips (Pending, Awaiting Proof, Verification, Delivery) pinned at the top. Tapping an order opens a Bottom Sheet to approve/reject receipt.

hero_stock_banner.alt: Pallets of white industrial bulk salt bags against a grey wall

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the NO BLUE rule: Ensure absolutely zero blue or purple is used anywhere (banned in links, statuses, primary colors, etc). The primary brand represents industrial trust using Emerald/Seaweed Green (#059669) over warm Slate/Ceramic whites (#FAFAF9).
Material 3 Execution: Do not use drop shadows. Elevation must be achieved tonally (using surface, surfaceSecondary, surfaceTertiary). Use pill shapes for tier selectors and language toggles.

Kanban Architecture (Learned from research): Do not use a horizontal scrolling multi-column Trello-style board on mobile. Instead, implement a vertical list of orders with a sticky, horizontally-scrollable chip row at the top to filter by status (Pending, Verification, Delivery).

Sticky CTAs: The 'Checkout' and 'Confirm Order' buttons must be placed inside a safe-area aware container fixed to the bottom of the screen, overlaid above scrolling content, without blur (use solid surface).
Images & Contrast: Ensure the hero_stock_banner has a top-to-bottom vertical linear gradient scrim (transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) to guarantee text readability.
Language Toggle: Implement an EN/ID pill segmented control at the top right of relevant screens (e.g., Home or Profile).
Forms & Upload: The receipt upload state should feature a clear dashed border area with Material icons. Provide distinct 'Approve' and 'Reject' states in the Admin verification sheet.
